# Krishnendu Biswas

> Personal chronicle, technical portfolio, and engineering profile of Krishnendu Biswas.

Krishnendu Biswas is an AI systems developer, machine learning researcher, and management scholar based in Ranchi, India. He builds autonomous AI agent workflows, conducts applied NLP research, and studies at the Indian Institute of Management Ranchi (MBA 2025-27, BBA 2025) along with a Programming Diploma from the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (2026).

## Canonical Profiles and Identity Links
- Website: https://krishnendu.me/
- GitHub: https://github.com/krshnndu
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/krshnndu
- Email: krishnendu.biswasi22@iimranchi.ac.in

## Core Specializations
- Multi-Agent Orchestration: Autonomous multi-agent topologies, tool execution harnesses, task triage daemons, and stateful memory workflows.
- Natural Language Processing: Parameter-efficient transformer fine-tuning (LoRA with DeBERTa-v3 and RoBERTa), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and sentiment/emotion classification.
- Machine Learning and Data Engineering: Imbalanced dataset modeling (SVMSMOTE), tree-based ensembles (LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest), hyperparameter optimization (Optuna), and SQL/tabular pipelines.
- Applied Research: Rare-event emotion classification, systematic literature review pipelines (PRISMA methodology), and economic modeling.

## Publications and Scholarly Research
- "Multi-Class Affect Detection in Educational Chatbots: Evidence from Imbalanced Dialogue Data" (Springer, FICTA 2026). Authored research on rare-event classification across imbalanced dialogue datasets; developed RoBERTa and SVMSMOTE framework achieving 74.19% recall on confused-emotion class.
- "Adoption and Implications of Generative AI in Marketing: A Systematic Review and Research Agenda" (10th Pan-IIM WMC 2025, IIM Ranchi). Conducted PRISMA systematic review across 29 Scopus-indexed articles spanning 2020 to 2025.

## Selected Technical Projects
- Smart MCQ Solver: Fine-tuned microsoft/deberta-v3-base and roberta-base via LoRA (r=8, alpha=16) for 5-option MCQ ranking, scoring 0.74242 MAP@3 on unseen evaluation questions.
- Comment Classification Pipeline: Evaluated 198,000 comments across 4 classes; engineered 10,000+ n-gram features and behavioral signals; achieved 0.8293 F1-Macro via LightGBM and Nelder-Mead class multiplier tuning.
- Customer Churn and Exit Prediction: Built classification benchmarks across 90,000 banking records; optimized Random Forest and LightGBM models yielding 0.6365 validation F1 on imbalanced exit classes.
- Virtual AI Teaching Assistant: Developed RAG pipeline using vector embeddings and SQLite store with FastAPI endpoints for source-grounded answering.

## Education
- Indian Institute of Management Ranchi: Master of Business Administration (MBA, 2025-2027), Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA, 2022-2025).
- Indian Institute of Technology Madras: Diploma in Programming (2026).
